children: Japanese listed company Iole plans to sell all 151.21 Bitcoin it holds, expecting a loss of about 254 million yen. According to Odaily, the company plans to sell on the market through cryptocurrency exchanges from October 30 through the end of November, possibly in installments. Iole intends to prioritize using the proceeds for AI data centers, AI computing services and its Neo Cloud business. The company said it will continue holding Hyperliquid (HYPE), which it began acquiring in July 2026.

title: Japanese Listed Iole Plans to Sell All 151.21 Bitcoin, Expects 254 Million Yen Loss
